nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Conventions guide for the @opencode-ai/ui SolidJS component package: SSR/HMR-safe module initialization (no module-level Math.random), tests co-located in src/components/, the theme system's context/loader separation with the triple-cache Vite glob pattern, and Storybook patterns (DataProvider wrappers, mock data factories, FileStub for the diff viewer, deterministic IDs for snapshots).

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @opencode-ai/ui, the shared SolidJS component library: subpath exports for components, hooks, context, theme, i18n, pierre, icons, styles, fonts, and audio assets; Vite dev server and tsgo typecheck scripts; and dependencies on solid-js, kobalte, marked, shiki, katex, motion, virtua, plus the workspace SDK, core, and diff-wasm packages.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses wildcard subpath exports (./* mapped to ./src/components/*.tsx) so every component is importable by filename without a barrel file; workspace:* entries link sibling packages through the Bun workspace symlink layout.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the UI package: SolidJS JSX setup (jsx preserve with solid-js import source), bundler module resolution, strict type checking, vite/client and bun ambient types, and exclusion of Storybook stories and MDX files from compilation.
nodes.languageNotes: jsx: "preserve" with jsxImportSource: "solid-js" is the SolidJS compile model — the compiler emits JSX untouched for vite-plugin-solid to transform, unlike React's classic/automatic runtime imports.
